# Iotron Claude Skills

Claude Code skills for web animation and frontend performance.

## Available Skills

### gsap-optimiser

Comprehensive GSAP performance optimisation for Vue 3 / Nuxt 3 projects.

**Covers:**
- Context cleanup (`gsap.context`, `ctx.add`, `ctx.revert`)
- GPU acceleration (`force3D`, transforms vs layout properties)
- `will-change` lifecycle management
- High-frequency animation tools (`quickTo`, `quickSetter`, `overwrite`)
- ScrollTrigger tuning (`batch`, `scrub`, `once`, `fastScrollEnd`, `invalidateOnRefresh`, `normalizeScroll`, `matchMedia`)
- `autoAlpha` vs `opacity`
- Lazy rendering & layout thrashing avoidance
- Timeline reuse & `registerEffect`
- `gsap.defaults` & `gsap.config`
- Ticker & `lagSmoothing`
- Anti-patterns checklist

## Installation

```bash
# 1. Register the marketplace
/plugin marketplace add iotron/iotron-claude-skills

# 2. Install the skills
/plugin install gsap-skills@iotron-claude-skills
```

## Usage

The skill triggers automatically when working with GSAP animations in Vue/Nuxt components. It provides:
- Performance checklists for every GSAP-using component
- Code patterns for proper animation cleanup
- Optimisation guidance for mousemove/scroll-driven animations
- Anti-pattern detection
